original_question: Let A be a Σ1_1(y) set. If there exists x in A such that ω1^{CK(x)} > ω1^{CK(y)}, must the Velickovic-Woodin conclusion already hold for A, namely that for every γ there exist x_0, x_1, x_2, x_3 in A with γ ≤_h x_0 ⊕ x_1 ⊕ x_2 ⊕ x_3?
target_in_paper: Problem 9(b) in Section 4 (Liang Yu): a parameter-relative strengthening of Theorem 8 (Velickovic–Woodin), asked immediately after Proposition 7 (Yu–Zhao). ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.03972))
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper very closely. It has the correct hypothesis that A is Σ^1_1(y) and contains some x with ω_1^{CK(x)} > ω_1^{CK(y)}, and it correctly expands “the Velickovic–Woodin theorem holds for A” into the conclusion “for every γ there exist x_0, x_1, x_2, x_3 in A with γ ≤_h x_0 ⊕ x_1 ⊕ x_2 ⊕ x_3.” This is exactly Problem 9(b) read together with Theorem 8. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.03972))
missing_details: The parameter y should be explicitly quantified: the official wording is “For any Σ^1_1(y) set A...,” so the stand-alone version should begin “for every real y and every Σ^1_1(y) set A.” ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.03972))

A should be identified as a set of reals, and the variables x, x_0, x_1, x_2, x_3, and γ should likewise be understood as reals. The paper leaves this ambient space implicit. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.03972))
The shorthand “the Velickovic–Woodin theorem holds for A” should be replaced by the full Theorem 8 conclusion if the question is to be stand-alone. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.03972))

The notation should be unpacked: ω_1^{CK(z)} is the relative Church–Kleene ordinal, ≤_h is hyperarithmetic reducibility, and ⊕ is the join of reals. Section 4 uses these symbols without redefinition, so a self-contained rewrite should name them explicitly. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.03972))

It helps to make explicit that this asks whether the weaker existence hypothesis “∃x∈A [ω_1^{CK(x)} > ω_1^{CK(y)}]” already suffices for the same conclusion as Theorem 8, whose stated hypothesis is sup{ω_1^{CK(x)} : x ∈ A} = ω_1. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.03972))

No ambient ring/field, homogeneity, degree, nilpotency, or “for all sufficiently large m” clause is relevant here; this is a recursion-theoretic/descriptive-set-theoretic question. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.03972))
refined_question: For every real y and every Σ^1_1(y) set A of reals, if A contains some real x with relative Church–Kleene ordinal ω_1^{CK(x)} > ω_1^{CK(y)}, must it follow that for every real γ there exist reals x_0, x_1, x_2, x_3 ∈ A such that γ ≤_h x_0 ⊕ x_1 ⊕ x_2 ⊕ x_3, where ≤_h denotes hyperarithmetic reducibility and ⊕ denotes join? ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.03972))
justification: The draft clearly targets Section 4 rather than any other part of the paper. In that section, Problem 6 is followed by the contextual remark “Related to this question, Yu and Zhao proved the following proposition,” namely Proposition 7; then Theorem 8 states the Velickovic–Woodin result; and immediately after that, Problem 9(a) and 9(b) are posed. Problem 9(b) is therefore the nearest official formulation, and it asks exactly whether the weaker relative admissibility hypothesis is enough to force the same four-real hyperarithmetic conclusion from Theorem 8. Your draft is already almost verbatim; the only real work needed is to make the quantifiers and notation explicit so that the question stands on its own. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.03972))
